notes.title: New Features
items: Use the terminal theme throughout the app

notes.title: Bug Fixes
items: Image controls no longer jump when switching images

notes.title: New Features
items: Set a preferred workspace for each tab group
Set or clear a tab group’s workspace with `actorterm set-workspace`
Syntax highlighting for Python and shell scripts
Select split panes from their redesigned sidebar header
Reveal files in Finder or copy their paths from split-pane menus

notes.title: Bug Fixes
items: Keystrokes no longer get lost when the command palette closes
Command palette actions no longer run twice
Window dragging between displays is more reliable
Text fields no longer apply unwanted automatic substitutions

notes.title: New Features
items: Float the session note over the workspace
Apply the LLM filter to selected note text from the note header
Search for snippets and action buttons in the command palette
Find action button sessions in the tab menu

notes.title: Bug Fixes
items: LLM filter failures no longer silently deliver unfiltered text
Markdown links no longer hide adjacent text
Command palette search no longer matches letters scattered across long snippets

notes.title: New Features
items: Compact toolbar on macOS 27 puts the window controls and tabs in one slim bar (Settings ▸ General ▸ Compact Toolbar)
Pick a tab from a horizontal tab strip, with rename, reveal in Finder, copy path, and close actions in its menu
File viewer can follow the terminal theme
Action button sessions are named after the button's title or command
Dictation keeps the last words spoken just before you stop; silent recordings are no longer sent for transcription

notes.title: Bug Fixes
items: ⌘1–⌘9 now switch between the panes the sidebar filter shows

notes.title: New Features
items: Program status changes from agents appear in the Info panel's notifications
Choose which notification types and agent states send a desktop banner (Info panel ▸ Notifications ▸ gear)
Choose whether banners show while the session is focused
Action button runs get their own sidebar filter
Restore a snippet to its saved version while editing

notes.title: Bug Fixes
items: Action button sessions no longer show up in the command palette or the attention count
Move to tab group menu no longer appears when tab groups are off
Snippets list no longer starts expanded in every session
Notification settings and program status are now translated into Chinese

notes.title: New Features
items: Turn off tab groups to keep every tab in one list
Show each tab's path under its title when tab groups are off
Sort the tab list by name, type, folder, or last used
Focus shows the tabs in the current folder and its subfolders
New tabs open next to the tab they came from
Sidebar shows when sync moves something
Sync carries prompts and snippets only; themes, fonts, and layout stay on each Mac
